_note: Craft lens, round 4 (past the cap, hard fails only), carousel no. 71, saved in shape. Noted the contact sheet was stale; re-assembled.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 04, 06 and 02 strong; 07 two flat slabs with leader dots on bare asphalt and aliasing; 08 blank folders with a leader through a label; mannequin figures on 05, 06 and 09; 09's riser notch; 01's pod a sixth of the frame.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, both devices working; 07 outside; 08 an undeclared second interior shift.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the round 3 repair holds; slide 3's trays loose; the December briefing printed without its year.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Mechanism, scale and funding land; no next date.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Clear order; the scale arrives late and 07's image blunts the turn.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain and local; 03's dek repeats itself.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New ground in setting; familiar hardware cover and staged world.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat slabs on a mid-brown road, dots on bare asphalt, no sky, aliasing.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A three quarter overhead so each card steps, the curb cropped, the road falling to black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Blank folders, a leader through a label, warm wood mid tones.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A single pool on the folders and labels stacked above their own folders.
